__broaden__.animae: anima, -ae (f.) — breath, soul, ghost (nom. pl.; also gen./dat. sg.) · also voc. pl. (animae, as address: felīcēs animae)
__broaden__.felices: fēlix, fēlīcis — fortunate, happy (m./f. nom. pl.; also acc. pl.) · also voc. pl. (fēlīcēs animae)
__broaden__.eadem: īdem, eadem, idem — the same (f. nom. sg.) · also n. acc. pl. (eadem convīvia) · also f. abl. sg. (eādem tellūre)
__broaden__.genitor: genitor, genitōris (m.) — father, begetter; here Neptune (nom. sg.) · here Jupiter, addressed by Venus (voc. sg.) · also nom. sg., Dido's father Belus (genitor Bēlus) · here Anchises (nom. sg.) · also voc. sg., Aeneas addressing Anchises (genitor, as address)
__broaden__.inanes: inānis, -e — empty, void; vain, fruitless (f. nom. pl.) · also m. acc. pl. (currūs inānēs)
__broaden__.melioribus: melior, melius — better (comp. of bonus) (n. abl. pl.; also dat. pl.) · also m. abl. pl. (melioribus annīs)
__broaden__.notas: nota, -ae (f.) — mark, sign, character, letter (acc. pl.) · also notus, -a, -um — known, familiar (f. acc. pl.: notās vōcēs)
__broaden__.tuaque: tuus, -a, -um — your, yours (sg.) (f. abl. sg., with dextrā) + -que 'and' · also n. acc. pl. (tuaque arma) + -que · also f. nom. sg. (tuaque exspectāta … pietās) + -que
__broaden__.vates: vātēs, -is (m./f.) — seer, prophet, prophetess (nom. sg.) · also m./f. nom. pl. (pii vātēs) · also voc. sg. (optime vātēs)
